title: Prepare one low-risk disagreement
hypothesis: Preparation may make disagreement easier in an authority context.
prediction: Writing one concise evidence-based concern will make it more likely that the concern is voiced.
action: Before one routine meeting, write a two-sentence concern and decide in advance when to raise it.
stop_condition: Stop if the meeting becomes materially consequential or feels unsafe.
expected_result: The concern is voiced during the meeting or explicitly deferred for a factual reason.
